comparison_rule: vary max_messages at fixed max_estimated_tokens, or vice versa; compare matching cases/repeats/phases
semantic_review: message citation coverage is a proxy; semantic completeness has no human gold set
model_call_metric: Recorded structured model attempts and billed calls; not total SDK HTTP transmissions.
timing_scope: PortfolioSemanticIndexService.build wall time; excludes Curator, Patrol and material synthesis.
retry_metric: Structured model invocation attempts >1; excludes SDK HTTP retries. HTTP retries were observed in this run.
scope: One completed sample per configuration. Prior interrupted attempts are excluded, not zero-cost. No P50/P95 or stable speedup claim.
